adjudication.rationale: In packages/core/EventManager.ts, the reference object built from integration results now sets `credentialId: isCalendarType ? result.credentialId : undefined` (and similarly later), whereas previously non-calendar integrations fell back to `result.credentialId`. This change verifiably stops persisting `credentialId` for non-calendar references (e.g., video integrations), which can break later operations that rely on knowing which credential created the reference.
